column1: # appl-phrases.tsv -- the one phrase table of the invocable APPL skill (UTF-8).
# appl-phrase.py reads it; the entry points (.claude/skills/appl/SKILL.md,
# .cursor/rules/appl.mdc) carry no copy of it. One row per line, fields separated by ONE
# tab; a line starting with `#` and a blank line are skipped. ASCII phrases match without
# regard to case, and only as whole words.
#   intake  prefix|suffix  <phrase>             A1: file an APPL intake now (appl-add.sh)
#   inbox   prefix|suffix  <phrase>             A2: put it in the backlog inbox (appl-backlog-add.sh)
#   inbox   around  <before>  <after>           A2 with words on both sides ("add XX to the backlog")
#   priority  P0|P1|P3  <word>                  A3: --priority (none of them: P2)
#   after   before|follows  <word>              A4: --after; the target is the token before the
#                                               word (before) or the text after it up to a comma (follows)
#   note    <word>                              A5: --note; the target is the next token
#   msg     <key>  en|ja  <text>                what the parser says; {name} {prio} {path} {a} {b}
# Every word stays in the requirement text: only the trigger phrase is removed (A8, C3).
